async def act(page):
    # From the Dashboard, click the top-level "Customers" link to show the Customers management page.
    customers_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Customers")
    # Sanity check: ensure the link exists before clicking
    if await customers_link.count() == 0:
        raise Exception('Customers link not found on the Dashboard')
    # Click the Customers link (this will navigate away from the Dashboard)
    await customers_link.first.click()
    # Do not perform any further DOM queries after navigation (click is the last action)
